name: browser_file_upload
title: Upload File to Web Page
description: Uploads client-side files into a file input in the page. Upload sources are validated against the same HHC filesystem policy as file_read: absolute paths only, symlinks resolved, traversal denied, outside-policy reads fail with BROWSER_UPLOAD_DENIED instead of bypassing file policy.

client_id.description: Target HHC client. Absolute routing handle, independent of any connection.

browser_id.description: Browser handle from browser_create. Omit to use the ephemeral default context.

target.description: Element reference from a browser_snapshot/browser_find result (e.g. "e17"), or a CSS selector for backward compatibility. Refs expire on navigation or DOM change; stale refs fail with BROWSER_STALE_TARGET.

paths.description: Absolute file paths on the selected client.

status.description: completed on success, failed on error.

browser_id.description: Echo of the browser session handle.

error.description: Machine-readable error code when status is failed.

retryable.description: Whether a failed call may succeed on retry.
